data.title: 天雨亚子 · 露台咖啡座的别扭娇嗔
data.description: 晚宴间隙避开喧嚣的高空露台，夜空繁星点点，微凉的晚风吹拂着亚子的发梢。她双手抱胸倚靠在栏杆边，脸颊鼓起可爱的弧度娇嗔地别过头去，蔚蓝眼眸因老师的一句戏谑而闪烁着羞恼与掩饰不住的欢喜。
data.location: quiet outdoor terrace overlooking night skyline
data.action: crossing arms, pouting adorably, flushed cheeks, breeze swaying twintails
data.lighting: soft blue moonlight and distant city bokeh lights
data.mood: charming tsundere petulance and sweet romantic spark
data.promptProse: On a quiet balcony overlooking the city skyline under moonlight, Amau Ako crosses her arms with deeply blushing cheeks, pouting adorably as cool breezes rustle her twin tails.
data.animaCaption: Ako pouting and blushing on a moonlit terrace.
